title: The Demon Path Saint's Request
next_chapter_hook: The runes on the ancient scroll fragment resonated eerily with the Tianji Record. The familiar patterns made Chen Ji's heart tighten suddenly—this was clearly a design he had seen in his father's study as a child.

text.content:
The blood-colored setting sun dyed the mountain forest crimson. Chen Ji supported the swaying Ye Qing with one hand, while the other still gripped the bloodstained short sword that had just slain three Holy Sect pursuers. The agonized screams of the pursuers had faded into the depths of the forest, the air thick with a heavy scent of blood and the acrid smell of scorched earth. Ye Qing leaned against his shoulder, her plain white garments thoroughly soaked with blood, her cold and elegant face as pale as paper, yet still gripping the obscure jade pendant in her sleeve with desperate determination.

Chen Ji gazed down at the jade pendant, his doubts sprouting like wild grass. That familiar presence, deeply ingrained yet impossibly appearing here—what did it signify?

dialogue.content: Where did this jade pendant come from?

Ye Qing struggled to curl her lips, a bitter smile escaping her pale lips. She didn't answer directly. Instead, she retrieved the jade pendant from her sleeve and spread it open in her palm. Chen Ji looked down to see that despite the pendant's vague markings, the jade quality was extremely rare mutton-fat white jade, with an incomplete character '念' barely visible along its edge.

"This... I found it in the depths of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds," her voice was weak but clear. "It concerns a woman who had been imprisoned for many years, her consciousness nearly driven mad."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. The incomplete character '念', a woman imprisoned for years—these details matched Chen Nian's situation, his sister who had been missing for years. Ye Qing seemed to sense the剧烈的 emotional fluctuation in his eyes, but didn't press further. She simply continued: "Chen Ji, I know who you're searching for. That jade pendant might be connected to the person you seek."

She raised her hand, tracing a vague rune in the void with blood-stained fingertips: "But now, we have more pressing matters to discuss."

Ye Qing's words were like a boulder splashing into a deep pool, stirring layers of ripples. Chen Ji helped her sit beside a blue stone, his gaze sweeping across the surroundings—the pursuers had retreated for now, but the Holy Sect's search would never cease. He needed to make a decision quickly. Ye Qing's 'Demonic Path Mist' ability could conceal the Tianji Record's aura—a treasure beyond measure for him. Moreover, she seemed to possess clues about his sister.

But how much of the Demon Path Saint's words could be trusted? Could the blood feud between the righteous and demonic paths truly be erased by a single alliance?

choice.prompt: How do you respond to Ye Qing's alliance request?

choices.text: Treat her with sincerity, exchange trump cards
choices.description: Reveal part of the Tianji Record's abilities to Ye Qing in exchange for intelligence she holds and subsequent cooperation, establishing a relatively balanced alliance.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's trust and more key intelligence
choices.risk_hint: May give Ye Qing leverage against you

dialogue.content: I can foresee events within the next three hours. The cost is the consumption of Heavenly Fate.

text.content: A flash of astonishment crossed Ye Qing's eyes, then transformed into an understanding smile: "So that's it. A Tianji Record holder... No wonder you've managed to hide in the Tianqing Sect for so many years without being discovered." She paused, retrieving a yellowed ancient scroll fragment from her bosom: "This is something I obtained unintentionally. It may be useful to you."

choices.text: Keep backup plans, each taking what they need
choices.description: Only engage in superficial interest exchanges, revealing no core information about the Tianji Record, maintaining room to withdraw at any time.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot gain Ye Qing's complete trust
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information advantage, reduce risk of betrayal
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may equally hold back

dialogue.content: Cooperation is possible. But I need to know—why did you choose me?

text.content: Ye Qing gazed deeply at him, seemingly sensing his vigilance. She didn't press further, only retrieving a pitch-black jade talisman from her sleeve: "This is a communication jade talisman from the Demon Path Holy Sect. If you change your mind, you can contact me through this. As for my sincerity—" She pushed forward a yellowed ancient scroll fragment: "This is something I obtained unintentionally. It may be useful to you."

The moment Chen Ji took the ancient scroll fragment, he felt the copper coin at his chest tremble slightly. He unobtrusively unfolded the fragment to see intricate formation rune patterns drawn on the yellowed silk paper, with ancient runes inscribed in the center. The pattern and arrangement of those runes bore some resemblance to records in his father Chen Xuan's manuscripts.

Ye Qing seemed not to notice his reaction, continuing: "This fragment comes from an ancient secret realm. It's said to have connections with all Tianji Record holders throughout history. The Holy Sect has been investigating the Tianji Record for hundreds of years, and I..." She smiled self-deprecatingly: "am nothing more than their pawn."

dialogue.content: Do you know about the previous Tianji Record holder?

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart rate accelerated abruptly. The previous Tianji Record holder—that was precisely his father Chen Xuan. Over these many years, he had never stopped investigating the truth of his father's disappearance, yet never found any clues. Since Ye Qing could produce this scroll fragment, perhaps she truly knew something.

Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, as if considering how to speak: "As far as I know, the previous Tianji Record holder was not some earth-shattering figure. He was merely an obscure wandering mystic, but one day he vanished without a trace. Some say he died in the depths of the Ancient Forbidden Land, others say he was silenced by some enormous force..." She looked up at Chen Ji: "But regardless of the truth, the Tianji Record ultimately ended up in your hands."

dialogue.content: Miss Ye Qing is indeed well-informed.

Ye Qing shook her head: "Not well-informed, but forced to investigate thoroughly." A shadow flickered across her gaze: "The Holy Sect has been searching for the Tianji Record for hundreds of years. They view each holder as a chess piece. These seers can peer into Heavenly Secrets, ought to be favored by the heavens, yet无一例外地走向覆灭—do you think this is coincidence?"

Her question was like a basin of cold water poured over Chen Ji's heart. The shadow of the Eye of Heaven's design resurfaced—those possibilities he had always tried to avoid were now spoken plainly by Ye Qing. Were the tragedies of past seers truly mere coincidence?

choice.prompt: The information Ye Qing revealed touches Chen Ji's heart deeply. How do you respond?

choices.text: Go with the flow, deepen cooperation
choices.description: Since Ye Qing has already shown sufficient sincerity, might as well advance the alliance further, laying the foundation for subsequent actions.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's complete intelligence network support

dialogue.content: Since Miss Ye Qing is so candid, I, Chen Ji, am not a stingy person either. If you ever need anything in the future, feel free to ask.

text.content: A strange glint flashed in Ye Qing's eyes, as if she hadn't expected such readiness from him. She nodded slightly, retrieving a small jade whistle from her sleeve: "This is a token of the Demon Path Holy Sect. With this, you can contact several undercover lines I've arranged. If you encounter Holy Sect pursuit, it might prove useful."

choices.description: Accept the cooperation proposal on the surface, but secretly observe Ye Qing's true intentions, maintaining sufficient vigilance.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot obtain key intelligence in a timely manner
choices.visible_reward: Make a decision only after seeing Ye Qing's cards

dialogue.content: Miss Ye Qing's kindness, Chen Mou accepts with gratitude. As for deeper cooperation... let's wait until both sides have shown sufficient sincerity.

text.content: Ye Qing seemed to have anticipated this, showing no displeasure. She simply smiled gently, pushing both the ancient scroll fragment and jade whistle toward Chen Ji: "Then let this be our agreement. If you wish to go further in the future, you may contact me at any time." Her gaze flickered with a hint of playfulness: "I believe that day won't be far off."

Chen Ji tucked both the ancient scroll fragment and jade whistle into his bosom, his gaze falling on the obscure jade pendant. He didn't ask about his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts—not because he didn't want to, but because he dared not. Years of planning and endurance had taught him to restrain his emotions at critical moments.

"This jade pendant..." he finally spoke.

Ye Qing seemed to understand what he wanted to ask, saying softly: "I cannot determine that woman's whereabouts for now, but where she's imprisoned must be related to the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. With your current strength, rushing in would only mean death." She paused: "But with my cooperation, perhaps we could争取到一些机会."

Ye Qing seemed to sense the weight in his words, a complex smile appearing on her pale face. The setting sun had completely sunk behind the mountains, night beginning to shroud this blood-soaked mountain forest. In the distance, flickering torchlight and noisy voices drifted over—Holy Sect pursuers were regrouping.

"I should go," Ye Qing struggled to stand, her form swaying: "The Demon Path Mist can conceal your aura, but it cannot last long. Use that jade whistle to maintain contact between us, but remember—" her gaze suddenly turned sharp: "Trust no one easily. Including me."

As her words fell, her figure vanished into the night like a specter, leaving only a faint lingering fragrance. Chen Ji stood motionless, the ancient scroll fragment in his hand, his eyes flickering with uncertain light.

He lowered his head to look at the fragment in his hand. Under the moonlight, those ancient runes seemed to tremble slightly. Just then, the copper coin at his chest suddenly radiated a scalding heat, producing some eerie resonance with the runes on the fragment.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The pattern and arrangement of those runes were exactly the same as designs he had seen in his father's study as a child. Father... could he have already known the secrets of the Tianji Record? Was this scroll fragment's fall into Ye Qing's hands a coincidence, or was someone orchestrating everything behind the scenes?

The runes on the ancient scroll fragment resonated eerily with the Tianji Record. The familiar patterns made Chen Ji's heart tighten suddenly—this was clearly a design he had seen in his father's study as a child.
